acceptance: Every gate in GATES has its mutation-sensitivity test run in a lane whose failure is reported (blocking or issue-opening).
A workflow test fails if a GATES entry's mutation test is not run by that lane.
context: Found in the 2026-10-09 tracker review while verifying df-parity-promote-tpc-family and df-parity-promote-nyctaxi-tsbs.
description:
PR CI runs tests/integration/test_cross_surface_mutation_sensitivity.py with `-k h2odb` only (ci.yml:766-770). The parametrized tests for nyctaxi, tsbs_devops, tpch, tpch_skew and tpcds run only in nightly.yml slow-tier-observation, which is observe-only (continue-on-error, nightly.yml:95) and is deleted by dlv2-70. The mutation targets and the drift guard exist, but nothing enforces that each gate still detects its mutation.

Run the full parametrized set in a blocking lane (trunk.yml or a nightly-v2 domain that opens an issue), within its runtime budget.
